scope: Two serial fresh indexes of one frozen actual Pastey source capture, control first then indexed, all publication and legacy SQLite/JSON exports included. Separate fresh Node processes, production index-worker V8 2GiB bound, no forced GC, no cache eviction; single samples not p95. No external semantic producer invoked; bundled TypeScript compiler included in ProGraph RSS. Source capture/hash validation outside timer.

limitations: No generated client or handler matching without explicit API namespace
No generated client or handler matching without explicit API namespace

runtimeDelta.compatibility: Additive indexes only; no schema, fact, claim, identity, eligibility, payload or durability change. IF NOT EXISTS adopts them on ordinary transactional publication; existing projection contents are reused.

sourceIsolation: Original Pastey checkout changed independently while the experiment ran (status hashes differ). ProGraph only read/copied it. Both analyses use the identical frozen copy; selected inventory is checked before and after each run. No original-checkout freshness or unchanged-current-status claim.

focusedValidation.build: Complete Node and UI build pass

rejectedAttempt.reason: Benchmark-only post-analysis SQL witness used nonexistent o.column instead of actual o.column_num; first control index completed but validation aborted before writing a timing receipt. Not a qualified before/after sample. Only witness spelling corrected; no product code, measured operation, durability or validation requirement removed.

diagnosticProfile.scope: Separate preliminary instrumented original-checkout run; not before/after timing qualification. Original checkout and cache state differ from frozen pair. CPU sampling and stage logs explain index choice.

qualification: Directional single serial pair, uncontrolled OS caches and other applications; not cold/p95 or million-line qualification. Entire support/navigation/compatibility/query construction, FULL/WAL commit and complete legacy SQLite/JSON export are timed. Original 60s/1GiB source gate remains unmet; no gate revised. Bundled TypeScript compiler shares measured ProGraph RSS. Scope rows grow with selected scopes; additional index disk overhead is measured.

sourceLineAccounting.method: Physical lines exclude the extra empty split entry after a trailing LF; blank/comment lines inside selected code files are included. The original raw per-file split counts and all timings are retained unchanged.
